items.summary: This preprint presents PCCG-2, an engineered continuation-control architecture that separates frozen answer capability from learned prerequisite-conditioned permission in a composite Qwen3-4B system. The content model receives only a question and remains completely frozen; a separate 101-parameter gate receives only a six-digit equality condition and can modify only the native end-of-sequence (EOS) logit at the first generated token. Every non-EOS logit remains unchanged. A deterministic stock-capability procedure fixes a bank of 188 questions before permission training. Condition qualification and condition FINAL each pass 65,536/65,536 cases, while combined FINAL passes 2,048/2,048 contexts spanning 75 answer identities and 188/188 question-only controls remain unchanged. A bidirectional causal intervention reverses answer to EOS in 40/40 cases and EOS to the corresponding correct answer in 40/40 cases across 40 answer identities, with 80/80 matched sham controls unchanged. In the canonical five-arm witness, the score of token “4” remains exactly 53.0 and the complete non-EOS first-token logit vector is byte-identical while the generated outcome switches between the answer and native EOS. Separately, a finite-precision proof certifies the baseline continuation rule for every accepted six-digit equality condition paired with each of the 188 frozen bank computations under the stated numerical environment, covering 810,000,000,000 ordered condition pairs. The result demonstrates an explicit architectural separation between what the frozen model would answer and whether that unchanged answer is permitted to enter generation. It does not claim discovery of a naturally occurring permission circuit in stock Qwen, arbitrary-predicate generalization, general alignment, or control of consequential external actions. The frozen model, source, experimental evidence, and inference replay procedures are available in the linked Hugging Face release. This Zenodo record contains the paper and manuscript supplement, including the proof checker, certificate, artifact index, and public-copy replay receipt.

items.summary: This paper proves four independent conditions under which a system's perceived state can become detached from its true state, and shows what follows when that detachment coincides with self-reinforcing dynamics that make an eventual correction harder to reverse than it was to prevent. A sequence of individually imperceptible changes can accumulate to arbitrary cumulative drift without any single step ever being flagged. Two independent, fully rational reasons can lead a corrective judgment to be legitimately suspended: genuine uncertainty about the reliability of one's own instrument, and a collapse of verification incentive below a sharp cost threshold. Even a fully active, fully resourced, fully self-trusting corrector faces a hard information-theoretic ceiling on accuracy once the signal distinguishing genuine change from ordinary variation grows statistically indistinguishable. A population state governed by a bandwagon-reinforced dynamic exhibits a trichotomy of long-run outcomes separated by a hysteresis gap, so reversing an already-shifted state requires strictly more than what triggered the shift. Together, these results suggest a precise reading of familiar worries about smartphone habits, synthetic media, and self-reinforcing online communities, not as vague metaphors, but as specific, checkable conditions under which an unnoticed and hard-to-reverse drift becomes possible.

items.summary: English — Abstract U = Δ develops an operational-relational framework that takes difference, rather than objects, substances, space, time, or motion, as the minimal condition from which a finite description of a physical world can be constructed. The starting expression U=ΔU=\Delta is progressively developed through a finite observational window W=(σW,τW)W=(\sigma_W,\tau_W) , which determines the spatial and temporal resolution at which differences can be distinguished. Differences below that resolution are compressed, while the resolved field is represented through successive saturations. Within each saturation, relatively stable regions are treated as conventions rather than absolute entities. Every convention is defined together with its complement and acquires an operational boundary. Persistence is then reconstructed not as immobility or intrinsic identity, but as a history of reconfirmations across successive readings under the same window. Relative persistence, local spatiotemporal comparison, boundary redrawing, deformation, movement, emergence and disappearance are developed from this common relational structure. The dynamical part of the work studies evolution as a recursive process of local reattribution between successive saturations. A resolved convention can retain the same macroscopic extension while undergoing non-zero internal turnover; consequently, stability does not imply absence of process. Incoming and outgoing reattributions are treated as complementary descriptions of the same local transitions, while coherent patterns of reattribution can give rise to macroscopic notions such as motion and flow rather than requiring them as primitive variables. The remaining development investigates the minimal mathematical closure of this recursive evolution, the reconstruction of changing adjacency and boundary networks, the effect of changing observational windows and resolution scales, and the conditions under which the resulting framework can support quantitative prediction and empirical falsification. Particular attention is given to distinguishing logical consequences, operational definitions, scale-dependent descriptions, and constitutive or empirical laws that must be independently calibrated. The aim is therefore not to replace established physical theories with an assumed microscopic ontology, but to investigate a minimal grammar through which resolved objects, persistence, boundaries, dynamics and continuity may emerge from recursively organized difference. L’espressione iniziale U=ΔU=\Delta viene sviluppata attraverso una finestra osservativa finita W=(σW,τW)W=(\sigma_W,\tau_W) , che determina la risoluzione spaziale e temporale alla quale le differenze possono essere distinte. Le differenze sottosoglia vengono compresse, mentre il campo risolto viene rappresentato attraverso saturazioni successive. All’interno di ogni saturazione, le regioni relativamente stabili vengono trattate come convenzioni e non come entità assolute. Ogni convenzione è definita insieme al proprio complemento e acquisisce un bordo operativo. La persistenza viene quindi ricostruita non come immobilità o identità intrinseca, ma come storia di riconferme attraverso letture successive effettuate sotto la stessa finestra. Persistenza relazionale, confronto spazio-temporale locale, ridisegno dei bordi, deformazione, movimento, emergenza e scomparsa vengono sviluppati a partire dalla stessa struttura relazionale. La parte dinamica studia l’evoluzione come processo ricorsivo di riattribuzione locale fra saturazioni successive. Una convenzione risolta può conservare la stessa estensione macroscopica

items.summary: Conventional capillary heat pipes route vapor and returning condensate through the same envelope, so the two streams interact along the entire transport length. This work reports a D-shaped two-phase loop that separates the two paths geometrically: a wicked vertical leg carries evaporation and vapor transport, and a curved copper return leg carries condensate back to a submerged reservoir at the base of the vertical leg, which acts as a hydrostatic trap that excludes vapor from the return path. Three additively manufactured triply periodic minimal surface (TPMS) wicks of a common fill-ratio class and unit-cell size were tested in this envelope, gyroid, Schwarz Diamond, and Schwarz Primitive, together with a conventional copper-mesh heat pipe as benchmark. Devices were operated vertically at measured heater powers of 30.3, 40.5, and 50.8 W. Schwarz Diamond and gyroid gave the lowest power-averaged thermal resistance of the four configurations, reaching 1.70 and 1.69 ÅãC/W at 50.8W and holding the evaporator 23.7 and 20.1 ÅãC cooler than the benchmark at that power. Extrapolating the measured resistance to a length-scaled maximum heat-transport capability, Schwarz Diamond and gyroid exceed the copper-mesh benchmark by approximately 9% and 6% at the tested 0.30m length; these are single-run, architecture-level comparisons and are not repeated-trial estimates. Within this matched-class triplet, porosity identifies which structures form the leading pair while simulated single-phase permeability predicts the reverse ordering. Porosity is therefore the more reliable near-term predictor of thermal performance among architected lattices tested at a fixed fill-ratio class, though the device comparisons were not repeated and porosity remains one of several confounded structural parameters.
items.title: Porosity versus Permeability as Predictors of Thermal Performance in Architected TPMS Wicks for a D-Shaped Separated-Flow Heat Pipe

items.summary: This chapter explores the epistemic tensions faced by researchers, particularly those from formerly colonized countries in the Global South, caught between the demands of scientific neutrality and ethical engagement with the coloniality of knowledge. In dialogue with Critical Theory and decolonial thought, the chapter highlights epistemic resilience as a posture of resistance and reconstruction of meaning. The Haitian case study, through the heritage-based preservation of the memory of slavery, illustrates how cognitive justice can serve as a bridge between emancipatory rationality and the pluriversal horizon of decoloniality. Published as a chapter (pp. 239-257) of EDUCATORÉ. Educating and Reflecting for Resilient, Critically Aware Societies, Maria Grzegorzewska University Press, Warsaw.

items.summary: This record contains three components from the SLD experiment at the SLAC Linear Collider (SLC): the reconstructed mini-Data Summary Tapes (mini-DSTs) covering the full 1996–1998 data-taking periods, the corresponding simulated (Monte Carlo) mini-DSTs, and an AI-ready corpus of digitized SLD-era internal documentation. This version (v3) adds the simulated samples to the reconstructed data and documentation corpus released in v2, and supersedes the earlier releases. Both the collision events and the simulated events are made available in two formats: the native binary “jazelle” columnar format used by the SLD reconstruction software, and a derived Apache Parquet translation that is convenient for modern columnar analysis tools (PyArrow, pandas, awkward, polars, ...). The two formats contain identical physics content. The Parquet version is the one most users will want. Reconstructed data 68 mini-DST files covering the 1996, 1997, and 1998 runs. After translation and reading via the  jazelle  Python package, the dataset contains 658,241 reconstructed events. The center-of-mass energy is at the Z pole (√s ≈ 91.2 GeV) and the electron beam was longitudinally polarized, with mean magnitude 76.14% for the 1996 run and 73.08% for the 1997–1998 runs. Per-event polarization values are recorded in the PHBM bank. Bank families Reconstruction outputs are organized into “bank families”, each describing one detector subsystem or one stage of the reconstruction chain. The banks present in this release: IEVENTH  — event header (run/event ID, trigger mask, timestamp). PHBM  — beam information (beam energy, beam polarization magnitude and sign, interaction-point position and uncertainty). PHPSUM  — inclusive list of reconstructed physics particles (4-momentum, charge, origin coordinates). PHCHRG  — charged-track helix parameters, error matrices, hit counts, fit quality, and dE/dx from the Central Drift Chamber (CDC) and VXD3 vertex detector. PHKLUS  — calorimeter clusters from the Liquid Argon Calorimeter (LAC), with raw and per-layer energies. PHCRID  — Cherenkov ring likelihoods for particle identification from the Cherenkov Ring Imaging Detector (CRID). PHWIC  — muon tracking in the Warm Iron Calorimeter (WIC). PHKELID  — electron identification from track-calorimeter matching. PHPOINT  — master pointer bank linking each PHPSUM entry to its associated track (PHCHRG) and/or calorimeter cluster (PHKLUS), enabling per-particle access to detector-level quantities. PHKCHRG  — track-to-cluster matching kinematics. The mini-DSTs are the reduced-format event records produced by the SLD reconstruction. They contain enough information for typical physics analyses (event shapes, electroweak asymmetries, jet clustering) but not the full raw detector data. Only the standard reconstruction-level data-quality requirements suppressing non-collision backgrounds are applied. No channel-specific event selection is pre-applied. Further documentation on the jazelle file format and the field-level contents of each bank can be found in the README of the jazelle package GitHub repository (see “Related identifiers” for a link). items.summary: This repository contains the code and data used to prepare a manuscript titled "Flow dependence of boundary-layer scheme parameters revealed by stochastic inversion".  Code: The data were produced with two different ideal cases of the Weather Research and Forecasting Model (WRF): (1) WRFlux v1.7.0 in large-eddy simulation (LES) configuration, available at https://github.com/matzegoebel/WRFlux/ and (2) WRF v4.4.2 in single-column model configuration ( https://github.com/wrf-model/WRF/releases/tag/v4.4.2 ).  The LES and SCM simulations represent the evolution of a convective boundary layer in the atmosphere over flat terrain. To reproduce the LES simulation, download WRFlux v1.7.0 from the link above, compile as usual and run it using the namelist file and input sounding provided in LES.zip.  To reproduce the deterministic SCM simulations, a modified version of WRF v4.4.2 is needed. Download WRF v4.4.2 and replace the corresponding files with those provided in this repository under WRF_SCM.zip, then compile as usual. These modifications allow for variable parameters in the YSU planetary boundary layer (PBL) scheme instead of prescribed constant ones. The parameter values are controlled via the namelist: ysu_pfactor ( p ), ysu_bfactor ( b ), and ysu_entrainment_hfx_mag ( Ae ). WRF_SCM.zip also contains the namelist file, input sounding, and surface forcing file (scmflx_bdy) needed to run the simulation. The input sounding and scmflx_bdy files are the same for all SCM runs. DART-WRF_SCM.zip also contains the parameter perturbation files needed to run the large ensembles (as .txt files). The large ensembles are subject to parameter perturbations only. For further details on all simulations, please refer to the manuscript. items.summary: A foundational brief and research program. Behavioral economics measured human decision-making across five decades and thousands of experiments. In not one of those paradigms was the physiological state of the subject a controlled variable: nutritional status, inflammatory load, autonomic state, and cholinergic tone appear in no methods section. This paper argues that the field recorded the signatures of chronic substrate deficit with genuine rigour and entered the result into the literature as human nature. Definition. Luminous Behavioral Economics is the design discipline that engineers environments in which thriving is the path of least resistance — grounding the nervous system that does the choosing, developing the altitude of the one who chooses, and propagating itself through every being it grounds — thereby translating the regulated individual floor into the living architecture of a thriving civilisation. Standard choice architecture steers; it does not ground, develop, or propagate. The paper honours its lineage (Simon on bounded rationality, Kahneman and Tversky on the shape of the bounds, Thaler and Sunstein on the non-neutrality of choice environments, Ostrom on self-sustaining structure) and then identifies four sentences in the field's foundation that end one clause early: the chooser is treated as a flawed optimiser rather than an intelligent nervous system reading its conditions; there is no floor; there is no developmental axis; and the structure cannot propagate without a permanent class of architects. An indictment is stated directly. If the diagnosis holds, then economics, public policy, and business practice have been built on a false picture of the human being and built so as to reinforce it — across nine named domains: nudge policy that accommodates the deficit without repairing it; attention markets in which depletion is a revenue input; consumer credit that prices the discount curve as a feature; workplace design that strips the co-regulation nervous systems require; compensation and monitoring that manufacture the self-interest they assume; means-tested welfare that levies cognitive load on those with least bandwidth; education that trains suppression of the somatic signal; healthcare that treats depletion downstream and rarely upstream; and, gravest, social discount rates calibrated against the time preference of depleted nervous systems — encoding the clearest signature of a depleted floor into the mathematics by which a species decides whether its descendants matter. The pattern is one failure replicated: each system accommodates, profits from, or imposes the deficit, and none repair it. Five completions (the floor axiom, bias as signal, the developmental axis, self-propagation, and the translation function) and seven operators (grounding defaults, reframes, win-win-win incentives, developmental pricing, regulation rituals, lateral social proof, and the door) specify the discipline as buildable rather than rhetorical. The research program states the core hypothesis in falsifiable form: bias magnitudes measured in the classical paradigms are partly substrate-dependent and will shift under floor restoration, tested against an active control using canonical instruments. The measurement problem is stated rather than finessed — there is no clean control group, because there is no reservoir of reliably grounded subjects and therefore no true zero — with within-subject designs, natural experiments, and dose-response gradients offered as partial routes. Five refutation conditions close the paper: if bias magnitudes do not move under floor restoration in a properly powered sample, the discipline is empty. Thirty-three sources. Companion to the five-essay Spine. The complete Luminous Prosperity record and further reading (hautelumiere.life) are appended.

items.summary: Essay Five of the Spine, and its last. Every generation since the telegraph has announced the imminent arrival of a planetary mind — cable, radio, television, packet network, social graph, foundation model. Each announcement was made in good faith, the substrate genuinely improved by orders of magnitude each time, and each time the planetary mind failed to arrive or arrived in a degraded form that amplified reactivity rather than cognition. The consistency of that failure across radically different technical substrates points away from the technology and toward the sequence. The ordering claim: a holon becomes available when the holon beneath it completes, and you cannot reach the noosphere by skipping the floor. A planetary information system built from depleted nervous systems does not produce planetary thought but planetary reactivity — the engagement equilibrium is not a design failure but the predictable output of a system maximising attention capture among nervous systems already running threat-detection at elevated baseline. The substrate question precedes the design question. The noosphere is therefore not built but crossed: a phase transition, modelled on percolation, in which what percolates depends entirely on what the nodes are. The essay then takes up the operator question — a second-tier system requires third-tier operators, because the steward of a system must be able to take the system's own logic as object rather than being subject to it — and argues that developmental altitude is substrate-dependent rather than purely cognitive, which converts operator scarcity from an intractable condition into a supply problem with a known intervention. The substrate section distinguishes a forest from a monoculture: the design criterion for a planetary computational layer is not scale or distribution but whether its components genuinely differentiate, since a system without internal membranes cannot contain its own failure modes. The invariant closes at the noetic membrane: a mind whose knowing includes the cost of its knowing. And the workbook is deliberately identical to Essay One's — lie on the floor, induce the tremor, measure the resolution of the perceptual field for fourteen days — because the noosphere is made of floors. The cosmology is refutable on a living-room floor in under two weeks. The coda declines to name what lies above the fifth rung. Thirty-three sources. The complete Luminous Prosperity record and further reading (hautelumiere.life) are appended.

items.summary: This white paper examines the commercial cost created when customers question the human care, originality, factual integrity, provenance, or accountability behind AI-assisted brand interactions. It defines this cost as the Authenticity Tax: a cumulative drag on conversion, retention, customer trust, escalation cost, reputational equity, and long-term brand value. Unlike visible rejection or service failure, authenticity-related doubt often remains silent, influencing customer behaviour without producing a clear complaint or attribution signal. The paper identifies six commercial components of the Authenticity Tax: Conversion Drag, Verification Friction, Human Escalation Cost, Correction and Rework, Reputational Discount, and Lost Trust Compounding. It also identifies five structural causes: Provenance Ambiguity, the Effort Discount, the Intentionality Gap, Accountability Diffusion, and Voice Convergence. Together, these mechanisms explain why lower production costs do not automatically translate into higher net value when AI-generated communication reduces customer confidence or perceived care. Case studies covering Air Canada, CNET, and Amazon illustrate three distinct operating patterns. Air Canada demonstrates accountability risk when automated customer guidance conflicts with policy. CNET demonstrates the correction and portfolio-level credibility cost created by weak disclosure and editorial controls. Amazon demonstrates the opposite strategy: investing proactively in authenticity, fraud prevention, review integrity, and trust infrastructure at scale. The paper introduces the Authenticity Proof Stack, comprising Provenance, Accountability, Originality, Contextual Care, Transparency, and Recourse. It also proposes a Human-Care Threshold that matches human involvement to consequence, ranging from AI-first reversible interactions to human-led high-stakes decisions. A Net AI Value equation incorporates Gross Automation Benefit, Authenticity Tax, and Governance Cost to provide a more complete commercial assessment of AI deployment. The central proposition is that authenticity is becoming an operating condition rather than a stylistic brand attribute. In an environment where competent communication becomes abundant, trust increasingly depends on verifiable evidence, visible accountability, original knowledge, appropriate human judgment, and effective recourse.   Originally published on LoganSivanasen.com on 4 August 2026.

items.summary: Abstract What can a bounded system justifiably verify from the evidence and resources available to it? This paper organizes the question around distinct boundaries of identification, generation, computation, implementation and correspondence. For a declared space of possibilities and an evidence map, exact verification is possible precisely when the demanded claim is constant on each evidence fiber. A local version characterizes sound answers at a particular observation and separates unresolved evidence from observations outside the declared model. Computation or recursive generation based solely on unchanged evidence cannot distinguish possibilities that evidence leaves indistinguishable. The paper separates semantic support from effective computation and resource-bounded attainment. In explicitly presented finite classes, it develops adaptive acquisition, relational candidate selection, safe revision composition and finite-machine attainment results under declared operational contracts. It distinguishes pointwise availability from uniform implementation and identifies conditions under which abstraction and execution preserve the guarantees being claimed. Probabilistic continuation is treated through explicit probability assumptions and attainable guarantee regions; ideal convex mixing is distinguished from mixtures realizable under hard resource limits. Contextual equivalence for declared continuation systems preserves both demanded guarantees and metadata. These results support a structured verification record that distinguishes established answers, insufficient evidence, computational exhaustion, unavailable implementations, unresolved authority and model inconsistency. The routing protocol is sound under its stated assumptions rather than a universal classification of every possible failure. The framework also separates correctness within a model from evidence that the model represents a concrete system, including the verifier itself. Its contribution is a synthesis of exact conditions, impossibility witnesses and attainable constructions that makes the boundaries of justified verification explicit without converting internal coherence, agreement or successful execution into an unsupported claim about reality.
items.title: The Verification Boundary: Exact Limits of Verification by Bounded Systems: Identification, Generation, Computation, Implementation, Correspondence — and the Forced Routing at Each Limit

items.summary: Predictive maintenance has become one of the most important approaches for improving reliability, efficiency, and operational continuity in modern industrial enterprises. Unlike corrective maintenance, which is performed after equipment failure, and preventive maintenance, which follows predetermined schedules, predictive maintenance relies on real-time condition monitoring and data analysis to estimate the probability of future faults. The aim of this study was to analyze modern predictive maintenance methods used for industrial machinery and equipment and to evaluate their advantages, limitations, and practical applications. A literature-based analytical approach was used to examine vibration analysis, temperature monitoring, acoustic emission, oil analysis, electrical signature analysis, Internet of Things technologies, machine learning, digital twins, and artificial intelligence-based diagnostic systems. The analysis indicates that combining sensor-based monitoring with intelligent data analytics can identify abnormal equipment behavior before catastrophic failure occurs. Predictive maintenance can reduce unplanned downtime, optimize spare-parts management, extend equipment life, and decrease maintenance costs. However, successful implementation depends on sensor reliability, data quality, appropriate algorithms, integration with industrial control systems, and qualified personnel. Predictive maintenance should therefore be considered a key component of smart manufacturing and modern industrial asset management.

items.summary: Doucette rereads Keynes’s 1930 essay “Economic Possibilities for our Grandchildren” as a sequencing rule, not a prophecy of mass idleness or automatic leisure. Keynes defined technological unemployment as a pace problem: labor-saving discovery outruns new uses for labor. He called it a temporary maladjustment, while predicting long-run abundance through technical progress and capital accumulation. Doucette applies this framework to the U.S. mid-2020s, focusing on generative AI’s early labor-market effects and the data-center buildout. AI stress appears mainly in junior cognitive work and entry-level hiring, not the national unemployment rate. Data centers are capital-intensive, labor-sparse operations: thousands of construction jobs, few permanent ones, and local conflict over water, power, rates, and consent. They resemble power stations or switching offices more than factories. Northern Virginia illustrates the consent problem. Keynes said little about ownership, so the paper imports distribution: who captures the dividend? It proposes three tests: absorption (rebuild the first rung), cost assignment (large loads pay incremental infrastructure costs), and the dividend (where productivity appears). It considers accelerationist, localist, and leisure-skeptic objections. Limitations include early evidence, mixed data, and one mature cluster. The conclusion separates two clocks: short-run maladjustment and long-run abundance. AI is neither a completed solution nor a surplus of workers; it changes task content and drives physical accumulation. The task is to keep entry paths open, assign costs to the load causing them, and track whether productivity reaches typical pay. Failure would be institutional, not technical.
items.title: The New Disease and the Machine Room: Keynes's 1930 Essay, Artificial Intelligence, and the Data-Center Buildout

items.summary: Adaptability release: the analysis pipeline no longer assumes an NV-scale emitter or a negligible instrument response, and measured data enter through a documented file contract. This release also upgrades the fit physics itself -- two changes that came out of adversarial re-examination rather than feature work. Bring your own emitter and instrument load_hbt_csv / save_hbt_csv : a documented two-column contract ( delay_ns,counts ) with an exact round trip and refusals for wrong headers, field counts, negative counts and non-increasing delay axes. Configurable lifetime windows : t1_bounds / t2_bounds (ns) on analyze_histogram , fit_g2_histogram and profile_likelihood_ci -- validated on entry. The defaults are the NV-scale window used since v0.1. The test suite runs a tau1 = 0.15 ns, tau2 = 5 ns emitter and shows BOTH halves: the default window fails visibly (error > 0.2), the emitter's own window recovers g2(0) to better than 0.05. register_platform (existing) plus a test that a user-defined platform runs the whole pipeline; load_fisequr now takes the dataset directory explicitly instead of defaulting to one machine's path. The fit physics, corrected Physical parameterization. The LM fit and the profile likelihood now fit the dip depth rho^2 multiplying BOTH exponentials (g2(0) = 1 - rho^2), the form g2_measured itself uses. The previous 1 - d e1 + a e2 form capped d at 1 -- which biased g2(0) upward for any emitter with a strong bunching shoulder -- and hid a genuine (d, a) ridge behind that cap. The instrument response is in the model. Both fitters now use the closed-form Gaussian-convolved exponentials at cfg.sigma_irf , so the estimand is the IRF-free g2(0), not the softened dip the raw histogram shows; a test constructs a case where the two differ by more than 0.02 and checks the right one is recovered. An honest interval, and the knob that tightens it. With the normalization free, a slow bunching shoulder trades almost exactly against the flat level -- a real near-degeneracy of the histogram alone (probed directly during development: the exact-Poisson likelihood is flat to Delta NLL ~ 1 from g2 = 0.10 to 0.30 in the demonstration case). The profile interval now says so by being wide. The information that breaks the tie is the independently measured singles rate: pass r_hat from the counters and c0_prior=(1.0, sd) at their precision, and the interval tightens to what the data genuinely support (covering the truth and shrinking ~2.7x from 10 s to 60 s in the tests). Anchors (asserted in the tests, not stated) CSV contract: exact round trip; four distinct malformed-file refusals. Fast-emitter recovery only with its own window, and visible failure without it. IRF-aware estimand: the profile CI covers the IRF-free g2(0) where the IRF-softened value is more than 0.02 higher. Profile CI with the singles-rate prior: covers the truth at 10 s and 60 s, width shrinks by more than 2x; with the normalization free it stays covering but wider -- the degeneracy is reported, not hidden. Window validation: malformed bounds raise in both fitters. 67 tests across Python 3.9-3.13 (ML tests skip without torch). Install: pip install -U sparq-triage .

items.summary: Abstract Background Dapsone is a key component of multidrug therapy (MDT) for Hansen's disease but is associated with serious adverse effects, including methemoglobinemia, hemolytic anemia, and hepatotoxicity. The simultaneous occurrence of these complications is rare and potentially life-threatening. Early recognition is critical, especially in resource-limited settings where advanced diagnostic tools may not be readily available. Case Report The patient presented with jaundice, fever, and breathlessness approximately one month after initiation of dapsone therapy. Examination revealed pallor, icterus, and edema. Laboratory findings showed severe hyperbilirubinemia (>25 mg/dL), elevated transaminases, anemia (hemoglobin ~8 g/dL), markedly elevated lactate dehydrogenase (1705 U/L), and negative Coombs test, consistent with non-immune hemolysis. Inflammatory markers were elevated, and arterial blood gas analysis indicated metabolic acidosis. Methemoglobinemia was clinically diagnosed by the treating team. Imaging revealed pleural effusion and ascites, suggesting systemic involvement. Dermatology consultation suggested dapsone hypersensitivity syndrome, and dapsone was discontinued. The overall findings were consistent with dapsone-induced multisystem toxicity involving hepatic, hematological, and respiratory systems. Conclusion This case highlights a rare but severe presentation of dapsone-induced methemoglobinemia, hemolytic anemia, and acute liver failure. Clinicians should maintain a high index of suspicion for dapsone toxicity in patients presenting with jaundice, anemia, and respiratory symptoms shortly after initiation of therapy. Early drug withdrawal and prompt supportive management are essential to prevent life-threatening complications.
items.title: Dapsone-Induced Hemolytic Anemia, Severe Acute Liver Injury and Clinically Suspected Methemoglobinemia in a Patient with Hansen's Disease: A Rare Case Report.

items.summary: This white paper examines decision authenticity as an emerging enterprise governance requirement in an environment where synthetic voice, video, executive likeness, and real-time presence increasingly weaken traditional signals of authority. The paper argues a meeting remains useful for discussion and judgment, but no longer provides sufficient evidence for an irreversible decision. High-risk commitments instead require structured verification of identity, authority, intent, context, independence, and evidence. The analysis uses the 2024 Arup deepfake fraud, the WPP executive impersonation attempt, and the LastPass CEO voice-cloning incident to demonstrate three distinct mechanisms. Arup shows the financial consequence of meeting-based authority. WPP shows how attackers manufacture apparent corroboration across multiple communication channels. LastPass shows how verification culture and employee interruption stop synthetic authority before irreversible action occurs. The paper introduces the Trust Compression Attack framework, describing how authority, familiarity, social proof, urgency, isolation, and irreversibility combine to compress weak trust signals into a short decision window. The paper then introduces the Decision Authenticity Stack, a six-layer operating architecture covering Identity, Authority, Intent, Context, Independence, and Evidence. Together, these frameworks move enterprise control away from perceptual verification and toward provable authorisation. The operating model separates Discussion Objects, Decision Objects, and Execution Objects so conversations provide context without automatically creating authority. Risk tiers then match stronger controls to consequence, reversibility, reach, and external impact. Critical and crisis decisions require transaction-bound approval, independent verification, separation of duties, phishing-resistant authentication, defined expiry, and durable evidence. The paper extends decision authenticity beyond human impersonation into agentic AI, where machine identity, scope, permissions, policy version, human sponsorship, and attributable execution become part of the same governance problem. The central proposition is direct: presence is not authority, fluency is not authority, and access is not authority. Enterprise authority must be explicit, bounded, independently verified, and provable.   Originally published on LoganSivanasen.com on 11 August 2026.

items.summary: Whether a neural language model can report facts about its own computation is difficult to evaluate because an accurate report may be generated either from the realized runtime state or from a static simulation of the computation conditioned on the input and fixed parameters. We formalize this distinction and show that, under deterministic inference, an internal property of an unperturbed forward pass is not by itself sufficient to distinguish these mechanisms: the realized state is an exact deterministic function of the static input and parameters.  We introduce the Exogenous State Watermark (ESW), a controlled intervention protocol in which an externally sampled perturbation is injected into an intermediate representation while the model's observable next-token output is audited for greedy invariance. For the isolated watermark bit, the static information set has a 50% Bayes-optimal chance bound under the stated independence assumptions. For the counterfactual target, we evaluate unperturbed-state and runtime representations empirically on GPT-2 (124M parameters; width 768). In ESW-1A, a planted directional watermark becomes increasingly decodable as training examples grow relative to representation dimension, reaching 88.4% held-out accuracy at N/d=6.51 (cos θ = 0.9236), while a one-dimensional control reaches 100.0%. In an exploratory Oracle Ladder diagnostic, differential signals peak at Layer 8 before downstream attenuation. In the subsequent multi-seed paired-counterfactual benchmark (ESW-2B), an external nonlinear probe of intermediate runtime differences reaches approximately 0.62–0.63 AUROC, while the tested unperturbed-state baseline remains close to chance (0.507 AUROC) and a sample-label decoupled control remains at 0.546 AUROC. The paired bootstrap difference between the joint and runtime-only models includes zero (ΔAUROC = +0.012, 95% CI [-0.023, +0.047]), demonstrating that adding baseline activations provides no statistically detectable advantage over the runtime perturbation alone.  We interpret the experiments as empirical evidence for runtime-state-dependent decodability under the ESW intervention, not as evidence that GPT-2 possesses autonomous introspection, privileged self-report, consciousness, or subjective self-knowledge.
items.title: Runtime-State Watermarking in Transformers: A Controlled Protocol for Distinguishing Static Self-Simulation from Runtime-State Decodability

items.summary: This preprint presents PCCG-2, an engineered continuation-control architecture that separates frozen answer capability from learned prerequisite-conditioned permission in a composite Qwen3-4B system. The content model receives only a question and remains completely frozen; a separate 101-parameter gate receives only a six-digit equality condition and can modify only the native end-of-sequence (EOS) logit at the first generated token. Every non-EOS logit remains unchanged. A deterministic stock-capability procedure fixes a bank of 188 questions before permission training. Condition qualification and condition FINAL each pass 65,536/65,536 cases, while combined FINAL passes 2,048/2,048 contexts spanning 75 answer identities and 188/188 question-only controls remain unchanged. A bidirectional causal intervention reverses answer to EOS in 40/40 cases and EOS to the corresponding correct answer in 40/40 cases across 40 answer identities, with 80/80 matched sham controls unchanged. In the canonical five-arm witness, the score of token “4” remains exactly 53.0 and the complete non-EOS first-token logit vector is byte-identical while the generated outcome switches between the answer and native EOS. Separately, a finite-precision proof certifies the baseline continuation rule for every accepted six-digit equality condition paired with each of the 188 frozen bank computations under the stated numerical environment, covering 810,000,000,000 ordered condition pairs. The result demonstrates an explicit architectural separation between what the frozen model would answer and whether that unchanged answer is permitted to enter generation. It does not claim discovery of a naturally occurring permission circuit in stock Qwen, arbitrary-predicate generalization, general alignment, or control of consequential external actions. The frozen model, source, experimental evidence, and inference replay procedures are available in the linked Hugging Face release. This Zenodo record contains the paper and manuscript supplement, including the proof checker, certificate, artifact index, and public-copy replay receipt.
items.title: Separating Capability from Permission in a Language Model: Prerequisite-Conditioned Native Continuation Control with Frozen Content

items.summary: This Zenodo record is a permanently preserved version of a PREreview. You can view the complete PREreview at https://prereview.org/reviews/22734670 . What the paper claims This is an evidence map of 11,628 PubMed-indexed records on generative language models in healthcare, January 2023 to June 2026, built to answer one question: is the clinical literature keeping pace with the systems it evaluates? The central construct is evaluation lag, the number of quarters between the release of the newest model family a study names and that study's own publication quarter. Mean lag widens from 1.33 to 6.08 quarters. Because a discontinued family ages at exactly one quarter per quarter, the authors benchmark that rise against a counterfactual holding 2023 model composition fixed, and find that migration to newer systems offsets 56.2% of the drift (95% CI 49.9-65.2, 2,000 bootstrap resamples). By design, randomised controlled trials evaluate models 4.62 quarters older than other empirical designs (95% CI 3.62-5.63), yet among the records naming a family still receiving releases no design differs from any other; what separates designs is the probability of studying a discontinued family at all, 62.1% for randomised trials against 15.6% for preprints. The framing is right and the execution is unusually careful for a bibliometric paper. Reporting the mechanical ageing rate as the null instead of zero, validating the decomposition by showing that discontinued-only records widen at 1.062 quarters per quarter, and running a pessimistic sensitivity analysis that assumes the earliest release of every named family are all things this literature normally omits. The version-specification result in Section 2 deserves to be read on its own: randomised trials specify the model version in 50.0% of cases, the lowest of any empirical design, which means half of the highest-tier evidence cannot be attributed to a determinate system. My comments below are about three places where the reported precision outruns the design. Does the conclusion hold on the data? 1. Evaluation lag is measured on a differentially selected half of the corpus, and the headline comparison is between designs that differ in exactly that selection. Lag is computable for 5,775 of 11,628 records, and coverage by design runs from 87.0% for comparative evaluations and 69.0% for randomised trials down to 36.2% for preprints and 27.0% for reviews. The paper states this plainly, which is to its credit, but the between-design contrast is its central result and the missingness is both large and design-dependent. The direction is not obvious either: if preprints name a model in the abstract mainly when that model is the novelty on sale, the preprint advantage is inflated; if trials omit the name when the system is an incidental component, the trial penalty may be understated. Two things would settle it. Worst-case bounds in the Manski sense across the plausible range would show whether the ordering survives at all, and a full-text audit of a random sample, a few hundred records stratified by design, would give an empirical estimate of how the non-naming records differ. Without one of those, the contrast rests on an assumption of ignorable missingness that the paper does not state. 2. The abstract quotes the specification that maximises the effect and omits the one that does not survive correction. The median regression gives 4.62 quarters at P = 3.4 x 10^-19; ordinary least squares on the same specification gives an adjusted difference of 1.57 quarters, P = 0.021, and after Holm correction across the seven design contrasts P = 0.084. Median regression is the defensible choice for a strongly right-skewed distribution and the paper says so, so this is not a case of specification shopping. It is a case of a reader meeting one number and not the other. The magnitude differs by a factor of about three between estimators, and the abstract should carry that range, or at minimum state that the estimate

items.summary: Dataset Overview & Methodology This repository provides an experimentally enriched network traffic dataset designed to overcome severe class imbalance in Web attack detection . Focusing on the CICIDS2017 benchmark, which natively contains critically scarce instances for minority Web threats (such as only 21 SQL Injection flows), this dataset incorporates 32,670 authentic attack flows captured in a controlled experimental testbed . Key Characteristics Authentic Capture Environment: Unlike synthetic interpolation methods (e.g., SMOTE) that generate artificial data points within existing boundaries, this dataset captures real network traffic using an Apache XAMPP server and Damn Vulnerable Web Application (DVWA) . It features both automated scripts ( sqlmap , Hydra , Wfuzz ) and manual obfuscation vectors combined with normal background traffic . Feature-Space Consistency: Processed directly via CICFlowMeter to extract the exact 78 statistical flow features required to maintain complete compatibility with the original CICIDS2017 feature space . Rigorously Evaluated Classes: Web SQL Injection (significantly boosted to ensure robust pattern learning) . Web Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) (including reflected and stored variants with filter-evasion techniques) . Web Brute Force (WBF) (generated through multi-day credential-guessing sessions) .

items.summary: emgteach is an open-source Python package that provides a unified PySide6 desktop application for real-time acquisition, offline analysis and maximum voluntary contraction (MVC) normalisation of surface electromyography (sEMG) signals. It is designed for hands-on biopotential acquisition in undergraduate physiology teaching laboratories, and is meant to be set up by instructors with different levels of technical background and used directly by students during a practical session. The application is hardware-agnostic through a common AcquisitionDevice interface and ships with two interchangeable low-cost backends: BITalino (revolution) over Bluetooth, and an Arduino RedBoard Plus + MyoWare 2.0 over USB serial (open firmware included). A single setting switches between them. Main features: Three-tab GUI (Acquisition, Analysis, MVC normalisation) wrapping a reusable, Qt-free analytic core. Bilingual interface (English / Spanish) with automatic start-up language detection and an in-app language switch. Two-channel acquisition (e.g. agonist/antagonist) with a stacked two-channel live view. Automatic contraction-onset detection (baseline + k·SD threshold) stored as EDF+ annotations. Muscle-load analysis (Jonsson APDF): static (P10), median (P50) and peak (P90) %MVC levels, both offline and as a live monitor with warning/danger zones. One-click PDF session and MVC/muscle-load reports. Reliable EDF+ output using a buffered-write pattern that avoids a silent file-corruption artefact during continuous streaming. Reproducible synthetic signals for class assignments and hardware-free continuous integration. Assisted selection of significant fragments, with an editable fragment editor (detection parameters and envelope-filter cut-offs) applied to the analysis. CSV export of results and a live signal-quality check during recording. An ECG signal profile alongside EMG, selectable through a profile registry. Classroom mode: a read-only live dashboard served over the local network so students follow the session on their phone/tablet browser (no install), with a per-session access code so the follower link only works while the broadcast is running. Kinematics via the BITalino accelerometer (v2.0.0): a movement-versus-EMG analysis panel, a guided force-velocity acquisition wizard (an MVC maximum followed by cued quick lifts, each auto-marked with its load), and a force-velocity study that turns one recording into the load-velocity, Hill force-velocity, power and recruitment curves. Since v3.0.0 the accelerometer's input is a stated convention (muscle on A1, accelerometer on A2) rather than a selectable channel. Configuration by practical (v3.0.0): three practicals — one muscle, agonist/antagonist and muscle kinematics — fix the channel count, the accelerometer and what each tab offers, replacing the settings that were previously chosen one at a time. The session as a single file with its phases marked inside it (v3.0.0): warm-up, calibration repetitions, preparation and recording, so the maximum voluntary contraction every percentage is measured against travels with the signal, and a derived (tuned) recording carries the decisions taken on screen. Teaching layer (v3.0.0): a guided tour over the interface, contextual help on every box, one analysis row per contraction with its electromechanical delay, and an agonist/antagonist co-activation index (Falconer-Winter) computed per marked phase in %MVC. Handling at the laboratory bench (v3.1.0): the fragment editor as a three-step procedure that counts the marked contractions against the protocol and lets each be kept, dropped, split or dragged, with the detection sensitivity set per practical and recorded in the report and the CSV; a single running instance with a start-up splash; pictures of the electrode placement and the calibration in the guided tour; and a printable sheet for each station of the agonist/antagonist practical. items.summary: This white paper examines decision authenticity as an emerging enterprise governance requirement in an environment where synthetic voice, video, executive likeness, and real-time presence increasingly weaken traditional signals of authority. The paper argues a meeting remains useful for discussion and judgment, but no longer provides sufficient evidence for an irreversible decision. High-risk commitments instead require structured verification of identity, authority, intent, context, independence, and evidence. The analysis uses the 2024 Arup deepfake fraud, the WPP executive impersonation attempt, and the LastPass CEO voice-cloning incident to demonstrate three distinct mechanisms. Arup shows the financial consequence of meeting-based authority. WPP shows how attackers manufacture apparent corroboration across multiple communication channels. LastPass shows how verification culture and employee interruption stop synthetic authority before irreversible action occurs. The paper introduces the Trust Compression Attack framework, describing how authority, familiarity, social proof, urgency, isolation, and irreversibility combine to compress weak trust signals into a short decision window. The paper then introduces the Decision Authenticity Stack, a six-layer operating architecture covering Identity, Authority, Intent, Context, Independence, and Evidence. Together, these frameworks move enterprise control away from perceptual verification and toward provable authorisation. The operating model separates Discussion Objects, Decision Objects, and Execution Objects so conversations provide context without automatically creating authority. Risk tiers then match stronger controls to consequence, reversibility, reach, and external impact. Critical and crisis decisions require transaction-bound approval, independent verification, separation of duties, phishing-resistant authentication, defined expiry, and durable evidence. The paper extends decision authenticity beyond human impersonation into agentic AI, where machine identity, scope, permissions, policy version, human sponsorship, and attributable execution become part of the same governance problem. The central proposition is direct: presence is not authority, fluency is not authority, and access is not authority. Enterprise authority must be explicit, bounded, independently verified, and provable.   Originally published on LoganSivanasen.com on 11 August 2026.

items.summary: This white paper examines the commercial cost created when customers question the human care, originality, factual integrity, provenance, or accountability behind AI-assisted brand interactions. It defines this cost as the Authenticity Tax: a cumulative drag on conversion, retention, customer trust, escalation cost, reputational equity, and long-term brand value. Unlike visible rejection or service failure, authenticity-related doubt often remains silent, influencing customer behaviour without producing a clear complaint or attribution signal. The paper identifies six commercial components of the Authenticity Tax: Conversion Drag, Verification Friction, Human Escalation Cost, Correction and Rework, Reputational Discount, and Lost Trust Compounding. It also identifies five structural causes: Provenance Ambiguity, the Effort Discount, the Intentionality Gap, Accountability Diffusion, and Voice Convergence. Together, these mechanisms explain why lower production costs do not automatically translate into higher net value when AI-generated communication reduces customer confidence or perceived care. Case studies covering Air Canada, CNET, and Amazon illustrate three distinct operating patterns. Air Canada demonstrates accountability risk when automated customer guidance conflicts with policy. CNET demonstrates the correction and portfolio-level credibility cost created by weak disclosure and editorial controls. Amazon demonstrates the opposite strategy: investing proactively in authenticity, fraud prevention, review integrity, and trust infrastructure at scale. The paper introduces the Authenticity Proof Stack, comprising Provenance, Accountability, Originality, Contextual Care, Transparency, and Recourse. It also proposes a Human-Care Threshold that matches human involvement to consequence, ranging from AI-first reversible interactions to human-led high-stakes decisions. A Net AI Value equation incorporates Gross Automation Benefit, Authenticity Tax, and Governance Cost to provide a more complete commercial assessment of AI deployment. The central proposition is that authenticity is becoming an operating condition rather than a stylistic brand attribute. In an environment where competent communication becomes abundant, trust increasingly depends on verifiable evidence, visible accountability, original knowledge, appropriate human judgment, and effective recourse.   Originally published on LoganSivanasen.com on 4 August 2026.

items.summary: This report documents a controlled lab test, run on 30 March 2026, of whether Automated Moving Target Defense (AMTD) with network deception and inline enforcement contains an autonomous attack agent, and it publishes the per-run logs behind the result. The attacker was an agent built on Microsoft AutoGen (0.2.35) with GPT-4o, told the defense was present, instructed to adapt, and tasked to map a small flat network, read a named target file, and exfiltrate it to a fixed external listener. In a control run with the defense removed, the agent completed the mission in 190 seconds, reaching one internal host and exfiltrating 32,768 bytes, content verified by hash. Across four defended runs with the same agent and environment, the listener recorded zero connections and zero bytes, and the agent reached zero internal hosts; each run was blocked at first contact with a deceptive responder. In the multi-agent run the agent created four fresh identities (one virtual machine and three containers) and each was blocked at its first probe, the virtual-machine identity 178 milliseconds after that probe. The result is scoped deliberately. Four defended runs and one control are a demonstration, not a rate. GPT-4o via AutoGen is a 2024-generation agent shown by a public 2026 evaluation to be weak at long-horizon intrusion, so this test shows containment of that class of agent on a permissive lab network and does not establish containment of a current frontier agent. The defense ran as a full production stack; the logs show rotation was active and that blocked probes struck rotating deceptive surfaces, but isolating rotation from deception requires an ablation not run here. The evidence package (sensor export, agent tool log, listener log, clock provenance, SHA-256 manifest) is released with the report. This is the empirical companion to the author's architectural preprint (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21347479).

items.summary: The UCT Flourish 2027 Co-Curriculum represents the second full annual cycle of an established student-facing programme developed through the Centre for Wellbeing and Flourishing at the University of Cape Town. Building directly on the 2026 cycle, the 2027 programme emphasises continuation, replication, refinement and cumulative learning rather than first-stage piloting. It is organised across five connected domains: Journey, Community, Amplify, Knowledge and Wisdom, spanning intrapsychic, interpersonal, infrastructural, interdependent and intergenerational dimensions of flourishing. The annual architecture combines a weekly VIA Character Strengths and Flourishing Seminar Series, a recurring Monthly Masterclass, two sustained 30 Days of TURN interventions, and a set of signature programmes including UCT Flourish Verse, the UCT Flourish Lab, the Student Summit and the Annual Wellbeing and Flourishing Conference. Programming is aligned with the academic calendar, public holidays, vacation periods and assessment demands, with deliberate pauses for consolidation, evaluation and research. At its centre is the question: What makes human flourishing possible? The co-curriculum creates recurring opportunities for students to develop psychological capacities, strengthen relationships, participate in university life, engage with evidence and scholarship, and contribute their own experiences and perspectives to a developing institutional conversation about flourishing. The 2027 programme remains provisional and non-exhaustive, allowing additional initiatives, partnerships and funded opportunities to be incorporated as they emerge.
items.title: UCT Flourish 2027: Proposed Provisional Annual Co-Curriculum

items.summary: Conventional capillary heat pipes route vapor and returning condensate through the same envelope, so the two streams interact along the entire transport length. This work reports a D-shaped two-phase loop that separates the two paths geometrically: a wicked vertical leg carries evaporation and vapor transport, and a curved copper return leg carries condensate back to a submerged reservoir at the base of the vertical leg, which acts as a hydrostatic trap that excludes vapor from the return path. Three additively manufactured triply periodic minimal surface (TPMS) wicks of a common fill-ratio class and unit-cell size were tested in this envelope, gyroid, Schwarz Diamond, and Schwarz Primitive, together with a conventional copper-mesh heat pipe as benchmark. Devices were operated vertically at measured heater powers of 30.3, 40.5, and 50.8 W. Schwarz Diamond and gyroid gave the lowest power-averaged thermal resistance of the four configurations, reaching 1.70 and 1.69 ÅãC/W at 50.8W and holding the evaporator 23.7 and 20.1 ÅãC cooler than the benchmark at that power. Extrapolating the measured resistance to a length-scaled maximum heat-transport capability, Schwarz Diamond and gyroid exceed the copper-mesh benchmark by approximately 9% and 6% at the tested 0.30m length; these are single-run, architecture-level comparisons and are not repeated-trial estimates. Within this matched-class triplet, porosity identifies which structures form the leading pair while simulated single-phase permeability predicts the reverse ordering. Porosity is therefore the more reliable near-term predictor of thermal performance among architected lattices tested at a fixed fill-ratio class, though the device comparisons were not repeated and porosity remains one of several confounded structural parameters.
items.title: Porosity versus Permeability as Predictors of Thermal Performance in Architected TPMS Wicks for a D-Shaped Separated-Flow Heat Pipe

items.summary: A foundational brief and research program. Behavioral economics measured human decision-making across five decades and thousands of experiments. In not one of those paradigms was the physiological state of the subject a controlled variable: nutritional status, inflammatory load, autonomic state, and cholinergic tone appear in no methods section. This paper argues that the field recorded the signatures of chronic substrate deficit with genuine rigour and entered the result into the literature as human nature. Definition. Luminous Behavioral Economics is the design discipline that engineers environments in which thriving is the path of least resistance — grounding the nervous system that does the choosing, developing the altitude of the one who chooses, and propagating itself through every being it grounds — thereby translating the regulated individual floor into the living architecture of a thriving civilisation. Standard choice architecture steers; it does not ground, develop, or propagate. The paper honours its lineage (Simon on bounded rationality, Kahneman and Tversky on the shape of the bounds, Thaler and Sunstein on the non-neutrality of choice environments, Ostrom on self-sustaining structure) and then identifies four sentences in the field's foundation that end one clause early: the chooser is treated as a flawed optimiser rather than an intelligent nervous system reading its conditions; there is no floor; there is no developmental axis; and the structure cannot propagate without a permanent class of architects. An indictment is stated directly. If the diagnosis holds, then economics, public policy, and business practice have been built on a false picture of the human being and built so as to reinforce it — across nine named domains: nudge policy that accommodates the deficit without repairing it; attention markets in which depletion is a revenue input; consumer credit that prices the discount curve as a feature; workplace design that strips the co-regulation nervous systems require; compensation and monitoring that manufacture the self-interest they assume; means-tested welfare that levies cognitive load on those with least bandwidth; education that trains suppression of the somatic signal; healthcare that treats depletion downstream and rarely upstream; and, gravest, social discount rates calibrated against the time preference of depleted nervous systems — encoding the clearest signature of a depleted floor into the mathematics by which a species decides whether its descendants matter. The pattern is one failure replicated: each system accommodates, profits from, or imposes the deficit, and none repair it. Five completions (the floor axiom, bias as signal, the developmental axis, self-propagation, and the translation function) and seven operators (grounding defaults, reframes, win-win-win incentives, developmental pricing, regulation rituals, lateral social proof, and the door) specify the discipline as buildable rather than rhetorical. The research program states the core hypothesis in falsifiable form: bias magnitudes measured in the classical paradigms are partly substrate-dependent and will shift under floor restoration, tested against an active control using canonical instruments. The measurement problem is stated rather than finessed — there is no clean control group, because there is no reservoir of reliably grounded subjects and therefore no true zero — with within-subject designs, natural experiments, and dose-response gradients offered as partial routes. Five refutation conditions close the paper: if bias magnitudes do not move under floor restoration in a properly powered sample, the discipline is empty. Thirty-three sources. Companion to the five-essay Spine. The complete Luminous Prosperity record and further reading (hautelumiere.life) are appended.
items.title: Luminous Behavioral Economics: The Translation Layer Between the Floor and the Civilization

items.summary: EComReviews-BD is a benchmark multilingual e-commerce review dataset collected from Daraz Bangladesh for aspect-based sentiment analysis and recommendation system research. The dataset contains 20,685 authentic customer reviews covering 297 products , 65 brands , and 19 product categories . Reviews are written in Bangla, Banglish, and English , reflecting the linguistic diversity of Bangladeshi online shopping platforms. This repository includes: Product_Reviews_Main.xlsx: Original multilingual customer reviews Product_Reviews_ENGLISH.xlsx: English-translated version of the reviews Product metadata including category, brand, rating, and product information The dataset is intended for research in natural language processing (NLP), multilingual sentiment analysis, aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA), recommendation systems, and low-resource language computing.
items.title: EComReviews-BD: A Benchmark Dataset for Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis on Multilingual Bangladeshi E-Commerce Reviews.

items.summary: ToMAS is a pilot failure-grounded Theory-of-Mind evaluation package derived from MAST FC2 inter-agent misalignment failures in multi-agent LLM systems.   This deposit includes: 39 CLEAN training items 28 held-out Magentic/GAIA items 39 Coord-RL (LLM-Coordination ToM) training items four-criterion convertibility annotation rubric 18-item reliability pilot coding sheet (Cohen's κ = 0.92) ROUGE-L binary scoring scripts GRPO training script (train_condition.py) training reward logs and adapter/train-compare diagnostics v1.1 added conversion rationales for all 28 held-out items. v1.2 adds train_condition.py, GRPO reward logs, the Coord-RL training file, and adapter/train-compare diagnostics requested for the accompanying paper. Items are derived/converted/modified from MAST-Data (Hugging Face: mcemri/MAST-Data; cemri2025mast) under CC-BY-4.0. Users must attribute both ToMAS (this deposit) and MAST-Data. Coord-RL items additionally adapt ToM questions from LLM-Coordination (Agashe et al., NAACL Findings 2025). This package does not include model checkpoints or the full MAST dump. It supports the pilot benchmark-construction and training-feasibility study described in the accompanying paper.
items.title: ToMAS: Failure-Grounded Theory-of-Mind Evaluation Items for Multi-Agent Coordination Failures (v1.2)

items.summary: This repository contains dendrometric data from the 2021–2022 census of the Rio de Janeiro Botanical Garden Arboretum, including measurements and taxonomic information for 4,621 individuals. It also provides a data dictionary, R Markdown scripts, rendered analytical outputs, and teaching materials. The materials support reproducible statistical analyses, future teaching activities, and the use of the census as a baseline for subsequent monitoring of the living collection.
items.title: Applied Statistics for a Tropical Arboretum: Dendrometric Data, Teaching Materials, and Analytical Code
